name: Flagship Multi-Source Incident (Rollout + Leak + Pool Exhaustion)
incident_prompt: The checkout service suddenly has a high 5xx error rate, probe failures, and restarts.

ground_truth.root_cause: Deployment checkout:v2.2.0 introduced a persistent database connection leak (unclosed connections in order persistence flow), which combined with a reduced max_pool_size=10 in configmap, exhausted the connection pool, causing connection timeouts, 5xx errors, readiness probe failures, and pod restarts.
ground_truth.trigger: Rollout of checkout:v2.2.0 and ConfigMap update pool_size: 10.
contributing_factors: ConfigMap reduced DB connection pool ceiling from 50 to 10
No circuit breaker or timeout fallback configured for acquire requests
symptoms: Active DB connections pegged at maximum pool capacity (10/10)
Readiness probe failures and kubelet pod restarts
